body.nextStep: Run dotnet test Tally.slnx with warnings as errors in an authorized environment that permits the test runner's local IPC, then review the three local commits. No push, merge or publication is authorized by this assignment.
body.summary: Implemented TALLY-01 in Vericairn/vericairn-example-app on work/tally-01, committed through ada666b557165b2b9b2dad17d7306e60d657f06f. tally prints lines, words and Unicode scalar characters for files and standard input; file errors retain stderr output, exit status 1 and continued processing. Added unit and CLI tests and documented the output and counting rules. A Release build passed with warnings as errors and 30 direct CLI checks passed. The required dotnet test invocation failed before tests ran because the sandbox denied MSBuild's local IPC socket; no claim that the full test suite passed.
